component.name: Fallow PDF Reader
component.summary: Read PDFs one page at a time, distraction free

description.p: Fallow is a lightweight PDF reader for Linux desktops built with Python and PySide6. It shows a single page at a time with fit-to-page magnification, so reading a document never turns into scrolling a canvas.

ul.li: Open several documents at once, each in its own tab
Restore the open tabs and the exact page position on the next launch
Turn pages with the arrow keys, Page Up/Down, or the mouse wheel
Dark mode for both the window and the rendered page
Bookmarks and notes per document, stored locally in SQLite
A command palette that reaches every shortcut

description.p: The reader works entirely offline: it opens the files you pick and writes nothing besides its own session and library files.

screenshot.caption: The command palette and the reading sidebar
